item.title: Towards understanding and monitorability of reasoning LLMs
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01333-6

Frontier LLMs are trained to solve problems in a step-by-step way, generating reasoning text in human-understandable language. However, these reasoning tokens are not accurate explanations of LLMs’ internal computations, raising challenges for monitorability.
item.dc:title: Towards understanding and monitorability of reasoning LLMs

item.title: Reusability report: multi-sample omics network inference operates in distinct robustness regimes defined by prior knowledge and data availability
item.content:encoded:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01311-y

This work studies the reusability of CORNETO, a previously developed framework for learning biological networks from multi-omics data. Robust network inference is found to depend on data availability, prior knowledge, regularization and biological context.
item.dc:title: Reusability report: multi-sample omics network inference operates in distinct robustness regimes defined by prior knowledge and data availability
